# North Macedonia (MKD)

Found: MAKSTAT (State Statistical Office) PxWeb table "Reported adult perpetrators by type of criminal offence and public prosecutors" — 23 basic public prosecutor offices (Debar, Kichevo, Ohrid, Bitola, Prilep, Kavadartsi, Gevgelija, Veles, Kriva Palanka, Kumanovo, Gostivar, Tetovo, Delchevo, Berovo, Radovish, Sveti Nikole, Strumitsa, Kochani, Shtip, Skopje, Skopje - organized crime, Resen, Struga) × 2023–2025 × 13 Criminal Code chapters. Homicide ("убиство", art. 123) is NOT a separate line; the closest is the chapter "Crimes against life and body" (which also includes bodily injury etc.). Extracted the Total and that chapter for all offices and years (rows.csv, 144 rows). The unit is reported perpetrators (persons), not offences or victims.
- Also exists (not extracted, same limitation): table 320_SK2_Mk_T15a_ml "Convicted adult perpetrators by courts of the first instance ..." — 27 basic courts × 2023-2025, but by sentence type, not by offence.
- All other MAKSTAT judicature tables (reported/accused/convicted by type of offence, which do include murder as a separate offence in national tables) are national only. SudstvoArhiva and DetPod folders: connection reset / only one archived table listed.
- Not opened: Ministry of Interior (mvr.gov.mk) annual report by Sector for Internal Affairs (СВР Скопје, Битола, Велес, Куманово, Охрид, Струмица, Тетово, Штип) — this is where murder counts by region most likely exist. The web search budget ran out before it could be searched; a direct fetch of mvr.gov.mk was not attempted.
